issues.issue: Did the panel err in finding the applicant not credible by giving too much weight to the Minister's statutory declaration?
issues.applicant_position: Panel relied on unsworn statements and the SD over sworn affidavits, without explaining why it disregarded them.
issues.respondent_position: Credibility findings reasonable; the SD showed differences that cast doubt on his narrative (para 25).
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, the application for judicial review will be allowed.
